joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

fixed.B_COMPLETION_FINALIZE: native in every arm; original completion boundary retained
fixed.workload_sha256_semantics: Canonical JSON hash checked by the original input loader; distinct from the serialized file hash below.
fixed.transfers: All original STORE/LOAD prepare, submission, completion and release paths unchanged.
fixed.warmup: original short32x16, short32x32, long2x2, output16; independent empty caches in every cell
fixed.arrival_sequence: Same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals; every request completes1024 output tokens ignoring EOS.
fixed.B_LOAD_ORDER: native, no LOAD ordering adapter installed
fixed.admission: Original native FCFS/cap256 and request priorities retained; candidate may postpone one eligible repeated recovery retry at the original waiting-head boundary without crossing/reordering waiting requests.
fixed.B_GC_OBSERVATION: identical passive callbacks in all four cells
fixed.B_RECOVERY_RETRY_DEFER: native/defer_once according to the fixed ABBA; sole policy variable
fixed.recovery_fit_or_repeat: No fit_once or repeat policy remains installed during service; true native baseline.
fixed.observations: Same compact output-event capture, native completion/order/allocation/source observers, passive GC callbacks and recovery-retry-defer action evidence in both arms.

plan.selection: One native/defer_once/defer_once/native group. Policy eligibility and bounded release are defined by retry_defer.py; runners pass existing selective victim/residency data without adding preemption hooks.
plan.scope: Probe a bounded waiting-head recovery retry delay against true native ordering; common compact capture is a fixed measurement representation, not a varied recovery policy.

intervention.native: Original retry behavior with identical qualification/action observations; no defer break.
intervention.defer_once: Pinned retry_defer.install(scheduler, mode, selective=selective) adds one bounded waiting-head retry gate; keeps queue order and all native allocation/transfer ownership. Cancels on baseline rotation override; exact eligibility/release is in the pinned policy.

plan.primary_readout: Verify actual deferral/release and request/task joins; all-request TTFT, completion, maximum generation gap, output throughput and fixed joint SLO. Retain failures/timeouts/unfinished, copy/output work, per-request cumulative recovery union, common GC intervals, post-observation materialization and phase times separately.
plan.stop_rule: Planned native/defer_once/defer_once/native. If first defer_once action_count==0 or executed_breaks==0, stop before both reverse cells with explicit STOP_NO_ACTION, retain all collected raws and release the group lock. Missing action evidence aborts explicitly. Otherwise finish one fixed ABBA. No automatic parameter sweep or repeated submissions; different-run events are not matched-state controls.

resource_checks.disk_check_scope: Session/cache filesystem once after acquiring whole-group lock, before first warmup; no per-cell threshold. Source/model unchanged.
resource_checks.disk_basis: Same-shape completed storage ABBA raw582171305B + caches324943122B + archive31726832B < 1GB; require3GiB before group, leaving >2GiB beyond measured group footprint. Original4GiB was a conservative runner check, not a hardware budget or experimental variable.

plan.storage_note: Native data disk nearly full; this new session and its independent empty caches live on /tmp filesystem. Model/source remain original read-only locations. No past raw removed.

gc_observation.clock: time.perf_counter host clock; align against raw measurement origin/end without altering raw timestamps
gc_observation.retained_events: All generation-2 collections and paired events lasting at least 0.001 seconds; this is logging detail, not a scheduling threshold.
gc_observation.short_event_accounting: per_generation aggregates cover the entire installation window; short events without individual timestamps cannot be exactly cropped to the raw measurement interval.
gc_observation.lifecycle: Record installation/uninstallation host time, GC enablement and thresholds; pair start/stop callbacks, retain pairing anomalies and pending_at_uninstall.
gc_observation.causal_limit: GC overlap plus randomized-free fixed ABBA representation intervention can test this storage source; other objects/host/GPU work remain. No proof about older runs or pure CPU pause cost.

deployment.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
deployment.runtime: Retained original package and model cache; native model runner/mixin/worker/scheduler/KV manager hashes match; private torch CPU imports passed with CUDA uninitialized.
deployment.comparison_scope: All four native/defer_once arms rerun on the same authorized GPU within one whole-group lock; older runs are not controls.

plan.source_basis: Frozen source_handoff native runner, original fixed1024 termination, common compact_capture and passive gc_probe. No recovery_repeat or recovery_fit runner in the inheritance chain.
